findings.evidence: CoprimeCosets.lean:55 defines the twisted representative as `σ · diag(p, 1)` (det p), and CoprimeCosets.lean:114 does the same. In this file, line 327 builds `!![a * f * p, b * c'; N, 1]` with det 1 and uses it as the right Γ₁ factor.
findings.fix: Say the conjugate factors as `τ′ · diag(1, p) · γ` with `γ = !![a f p, b c′; N, 1] ∈ Γ₁(N)` (writing `c = N c′`), so that `diag(1, p) · γ` is the twisted representative `σ · diag(p, 1)`. Drop 'last'.
findings.issue: The module docstring calls `!![a f p, b c′; N, 1]` 'the twisted representative … of the last right coset'. That matrix is the Γ₁(N) factor γ, not a coset representative, and `c′` is never introduced (the text only defines `a, b, c, e, f`).

findings.evidence: Lines 303-307: the hypotheses are only `hp` and `hσ`, and the conclusion is `∃ τ γ : SL(2, ℤ), … = conjDiag a b ((N : ℤ) * c') ((p : ℤ) * f) (p : ℤ)`.
findings.fix: Adapt the docstring to the actual statement, e.g. 'The twisted branch at the level of integer matrices: a Bézout relation `a f p − b c′ N = 1` factors `conjDiag` as `τ′ · diag(1, p) · γ` with `τ′, γ ∈ Γ₁(N)`', matching the coprime counterpart at line 204.
findings.issue: The docstring of the private `exists_mem_Gamma1_mul_diag_mul_eq_conjDiag_twisted_of_bezout` repeats the public headline 'Conjugation by Γ₀(N) fixes the double coset of diag(1, p)'. The lemma's statement is only an integer-matrix factorization of `conjDiag a b (N c') (p f) p` from `a f p − b c′ N = 1`; it has no `g` and no double coset.

findings.fix: Keep the result sentence. If the construction should stay, move it to the module docstring and drop the reference to the private `conjTau_gamma1`.
findings.issue: The public docstring of `conj_natDiagGL_mem_doubleCoset_of_isCoprime` describes the proof (Bézout offset, factorization, 'τ by `conjTau_gamma1`') and cites a private lemma that readers of the API cannot see.

findings.evidence: Lines 356-359: 'They are genuinely different constructions — … the twist `!![a f p, b c′; N, 1]` — and neither covers the other, so the case split is not an artefact of the proof.' The statement (lines 360-364) mentions only `p`, `g` and `N`.
findings.fix: Reduce it to the result, noting that it combines `_of_dvd` and `_of_isCoprime`, which cover all cases at a prime. Leave the explanation of why both branches are needed to the module docstring, which already gives it.
findings.issue: The public docstring of `conj_natDiagGL_mem_doubleCoset_of_prime` defends the proof's case split ('not an artefact of the proof'). It also uses `a f p, b c′`, which this theorem's statement never defines.

summary: The new file has a module docstring and all three public theorems are documented, but the module docstring and a private lemma describe their matrices or statement inaccurately, and two public theorem docstrings describe the proof instead of the result.
